```{r}
############################################################
# SCI Stage 2
# Lock discovery signature in GSE151371
# Project discovery-derived frozen scores into GSE293559; participant reuse limits validation claims
#
# Author: Peizhong Gao project workflow
# Purpose:
#   1. Use GSE151371 raw counts only to lock innate/adaptive signature.
#   2. Directly score GSE293559 without re-selecting genes.
#
# Required input files in working directory:
#   1) GSE151371_raw_gene_counts_de-ID.csv
#   2) GSE293559_Normalized_Morrison_2025_processed_data.txt
#   3) GSE293559_sample_metadata_curated.csv
#
# Optional:
#   4) GSE151371_metadata.csv
#      Required columns: sample, group
#      group must be one of HC, TC, SCI
#
# Main outputs:
#   01_discovery_signature/
#   02_external_validation_GSE293559/
############################################################


############################
# 0. User settings
############################

set.seed(20260713)

gse151371_count_file <- "GSE151371_raw_gene_counts_de-ID.csv"
gse151371_meta_file  <- "GSE151371_metadata.csv"

gse293559_expr_file  <- "GSE293559_Normalized_Morrison_2025_processed_data.txt"
gse293559_meta_file  <- "GSE293559_sample_metadata_curated.csv"

outdir_discovery <- "01_discovery_signature"
outdir_validation <- "02_external_validation_GSE293559"

dir.create(outdir_discovery, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(outdir_validation, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Stability-selection parameters
B <- 500
subsample_fraction <- 0.80
top_n_per_module_per_iteration <- 15
min_selection_frequency <- 0.40
min_direction_consistency <- 0.80
min_genes_per_module <- 5
max_genes_per_module <- 20

# Differential-expression thresholds for reporting
fdr_cutoff_report <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff_report <- 1


############################
# 1. Package loading
############################

required_pkgs <- c(
  "data.table",
  "edgeR",
  "limma",
  "ggplot2",
  "jsonlite",
  "AnnotationDbi",
  "org.Hs.eg.db"
)

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
    "\nPlease install CRAN packages with install.packages(), and Bioconductor packages with BiocManager::install()."
  )
}

library(data.table)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)


############################
# 2. Helper functions
############################

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("\\..*$", "", x)
  x
}

extract_ensembl_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- regmatches(x, regexpr("ENSG[0-9]+", x))
  out[out == ""] <- NA
  out
}

collapse_duplicate_rows <- function(mat, method = c("mean", "sum")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  rn <- rownames(mat)

  if (any(is.na(rn)) || any(rn == "")) {
    keep <- !is.na(rn) & rn != ""
    mat <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    rn <- rownames(mat)
  }

  if (!anyDuplicated(rn)) {
    return(mat)
  }

  if (method == "sum") {
    out <- rowsum(mat, group = rn, reorder = FALSE)
  } else {
    out <- rowsum(mat, group = rn, reorder = FALSE)
    tab <- table(rn)
    out <- out / as.numeric(tab[rownames(out)])
  }

  out
}

infer_gse151371_group <- function(sample_names) {
  s <- sample_names
  s_low <- tolower(s)

  group <- rep(NA_character_, length(s))

  group[grepl("sci", s_low)] <- "SCI"

  group[
    grepl("trauma", s_low) |
      grepl("^tc", s_low) |
      grepl("_tc", s_low) |
      grepl("-tc", s_low) |
      grepl("tc[0-9]", s_low)
  ] <- "TC"

  group[
    grepl("healthy", s_low) |
      grepl("control", s_low) |
      grepl("^hc", s_low) |
      grepl("_hc", s_low) |
      grepl("-hc", s_low) |
      grepl("hc[0-9]", s_low)
  ] <- "HC"

  # If a sample contains both "control" and "trauma", trauma control should win.
  group[
    grepl("trauma", s_low) |
      grepl("^tc", s_low) |
      grepl("_tc", s_low) |
      grepl("-tc", s_low) |
      grepl("tc[0-9]", s_low)
  ] <- "TC"

  data.frame(
    sample = sample_names,
    group = group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

read_count_matrix <- function(file) {
  message("Reading count matrix: ", file)

  dt <- data.table::fread(file, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  # Guess gene column.
  possible_gene_cols <- c(
    "gene", "Gene", "genes", "Genes",
    "symbol", "Symbol", "SYMBOL",
    "gene_symbol", "GeneSymbol", "Gene.symbol",
    "ID", "id", "Geneid", "GeneID"
  )

  gene_col <- intersect(possible_gene_cols, colnames(dt))[1]

  if (is.na(gene_col)) {
    gene_col <- colnames(dt)[1]
  }

  genes <- clean_gene_symbol(dt[[gene_col]])

  mat_df <- dt[, setdiff(colnames(dt), gene_col), drop = FALSE]

  # Keep numeric-like columns only.
  numeric_ok <- vapply(mat_df, function(z) {
    suppressWarnings(all(!is.na(as.numeric(as.character(z)))))
  }, logical(1))

  mat_df <- mat_df[, numeric_ok, drop = FALSE]

  mat <- as.matrix(sapply(mat_df, function(z) as.numeric(as.character(z))))
  rownames(mat) <- genes
  colnames(mat) <- colnames(mat_df)

  mat <- mat[!is.na(rownames(mat)) & rownames(mat) != "", , drop = FALSE]
  mat <- collapse_duplicate_rows(mat, method = "sum")

  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  mat
}

read_metadata_or_infer <- function(sample_names, meta_file) {
  if (file.exists(meta_file)) {
    message("Reading GSE151371 metadata: ", meta_file)

    meta <- data.table::fread(meta_file, data.table = FALSE)
    colnames(meta) <- tolower(colnames(meta))

    if (!all(c("sample", "group") %in% colnames(meta))) {
      stop("GSE151371_metadata.csv must contain columns: sample, group")
    }

    meta <- meta[, c("sample", "group")]
    meta$sample <- as.character(meta$sample)
    meta$group <- toupper(as.character(meta$group))

  } else {
    message("No GSE151371_metadata.csv found. Trying to infer group from sample names.")
    meta <- infer_gse151371_group(sample_names)
  }

  meta <- meta[meta$sample %in% sample_names, , drop = FALSE]

  missing_samples <- setdiff(sample_names, meta$sample)
  if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Metadata missing samples: ",
      paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (any(is.na(meta$group))) {
    bad <- meta$sample[is.na(meta$group)]
    stop(
      "Could not infer group for samples: ",
      paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
      "\nPlease provide GSE151371_metadata.csv with columns sample, group."
    )
  }

  meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI"))

  if (any(is.na(meta$group))) {
    stop("Group must be one of HC, TC, SCI.")
  }

  meta <- meta[match(sample_names, meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]

  meta
}

run_voom_limma <- function(counts, meta) {
  stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) == meta$sample))

  group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("HC", "TC", "SCI"))
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
  colnames(design) <- levels(group)

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts)
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, design = design)

  if (sum(keep) < 1000) {
    warning("Fewer than 1000 genes retained by filterByExpr. Please check count matrix and metadata.")
  }

  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")

  v <- limma::voom(y, design, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)

  contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
    SCI_vs_TC = SCI - TC,
    SCI_vs_HC = SCI - HC,
    TC_vs_HC  = TC - HC,
    levels = design
  )

  fit2 <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit2)

  list(
    y = y,
    v = v,
    fit = fit2,
    design = design,
    contrasts = contrast_matrix
  )
}

top_table_all <- function(fit, coef_name) {
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  tt$gene <- rownames(tt)
  tt <- tt[, c("gene", setdiff(colnames(tt), "gene"))]
  rownames(tt) <- NULL
  tt
}

safe_sd <- function(x) {
  s <- stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) {
    s <- NA_real_
  }
  s
}

control_referenced_z_score <- function(expr, meta, genes, ref_group) {
  # expr: genes x samples
  # meta: columns sample, group
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr))

  if (length(genes) == 0) {
    stop("No signature genes found in expression matrix.")
  }

  meta <- meta[match(colnames(expr), meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]

  ref_samples <- meta$sample[as.character(meta$group) == ref_group]
  ref_samples <- intersect(ref_samples, colnames(expr))

  if (length(ref_samples) < 2) {
    stop("Reference group has fewer than 2 samples: ", ref_group)
  }

  x <- expr[genes, , drop = FALSE]

  ref_mean <- rowMeans(x[, ref_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  ref_sd <- apply(x[, ref_samples, drop = FALSE], 1, safe_sd)

  valid <- !is.na(ref_sd) & ref_sd > 0

  x <- x[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  ref_mean <- ref_mean[valid]
  ref_sd <- ref_sd[valid]

  z <- sweep(x, 1, ref_mean, "-")
  z <- sweep(z, 1, ref_sd, "/")

  score <- colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)

  list(
    score = score,
    z = z,
    genes_requested = genes,
    genes_used = rownames(z),
    n_requested = length(genes),
    n_used = nrow(z)
  )
}

hedges_g <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]

  nx <- length(x)
  ny <- length(y)

  if (nx < 2 || ny < 2) return(NA_real_)

  sx <- stats::var(x)
  sy <- stats::var(y)

  sp <- sqrt(((nx - 1) * sx + (ny - 1) * sy) / (nx + ny - 2))

  if (!is.finite(sp) || sp == 0) return(NA_real_)

  d <- (mean(x) - mean(y)) / sp
  J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (nx + ny) - 9)

  d * J
}

bootstrap_hedges_ci <- function(x, y, n_boot = 2000, conf = 0.95) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]

  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) {
    return(c(ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_))
  }

  vals <- replicate(n_boot, {
    xb <- sample(x, replace = TRUE)
    yb <- sample(y, replace = TRUE)
    hedges_g(xb, yb)
  })

  alpha <- (1 - conf) / 2
  stats::quantile(vals, probs = c(alpha, 1 - alpha), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE) |>
    setNames(c("ci_low", "ci_high"))
}

compare_two_groups <- function(df, score_col, group_col = "group", group_case = "SCI", group_ref = "CTL") {
  d <- df[is.finite(df[[score_col]]) & df[[group_col]] %in% c(group_case, group_ref), , drop = FALSE]

  x <- d[[score_col]][d[[group_col]] == group_case]
  y <- d[[score_col]][d[[group_col]] == group_ref]

  p <- tryCatch(
    stats::wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  g <- hedges_g(x, y)
  ci <- bootstrap_hedges_ci(x, y)

  data.frame(
    score = score_col,
    group_case = group_case,
    group_ref = group_ref,
    n_case = length(x),
    n_ref = length(y),
    mean_case = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ref = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_case = stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ref = stats::median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    hedges_g = g,
    hedges_g_ci_low = ci[1],
    hedges_g_ci_high = ci[2],
    wilcox_p = p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

plot_score_boxplot <- function(df, score_col, title, outfile, group_col = "group") {
  d <- df[df[[group_col]] %in% c("CTL", "SCI"), , drop = FALSE]
  d[[group_col]] <- factor(d[[group_col]], levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes_string(x = group_col, y = score_col, fill = group_col)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.70) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  ggsave(outfile, p, width = 4.2, height = 4.0)
}

parse_gse293559_metadata_if_needed <- function(expr_sample_names, meta_file) {
  if (file.exists(meta_file)) {
    message("Reading curated GSE293559 metadata: ", meta_file)
    meta <- data.table::fread(meta_file, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

    # Normalize likely column names.
    cn <- colnames(meta)

    if (!"library_name" %in% cn) {
      if ("Library name" %in% cn) {
        colnames(meta)[colnames(meta) == "Library name"] <- "library_name"
      } else if ("sample" %in% cn) {
        colnames(meta)[colnames(meta) == "sample"] <- "library_name"
      }
    }

    if (!"group" %in% colnames(meta)) {
      stop("GSE293559 metadata must contain a group column.")
    }

    meta$library_name <- as.character(meta$library_name)
    meta$group <- as.character(meta$group)

  } else {
    message("No curated GSE293559 metadata found. Inferring minimal metadata from library names.")

    library_name <- expr_sample_names

    subject_id <- sub("v0$", "", library_name, ignore.case = TRUE)

    group <- ifelse(subject_id %in% paste0("ID", 13:21), "CTL", "SCI")

    reused <- subject_id %in% c(paste0("ID", 1:10), paste0("ID", 13:21))

    meta <- data.frame(
      library_name = library_name,
      subject_id = subject_id,
      group = group,
      treatment = ifelse(group == "SCI", "Acute", "Control"),
      reused_from_gse226238 = reused,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Harmonize names.
  if (!"sample" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$sample <- meta$library_name
  }

  if (!"subject_id" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$subject_id <- sub("v0$", "", meta$library_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  if (!"reused_from_gse226238" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$reused_from_gse226238 <- meta$subject_id %in% c(paste0("ID", 1:10), paste0("ID", 13:21))
  }

  meta$group <- toupper(meta$group)
  meta$group[meta$group %in% c("CONTROL", "CTRL", "UNINJURED")] <- "CTL"

  meta <- meta[meta$library_name %in% expr_sample_names, , drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta[match(expr_sample_names, meta$library_name), , drop = FALSE]

  if (any(is.na(meta$group))) {
    stop("Some GSE293559 samples have missing group.")
  }

  meta$sample <- meta$library_name

  meta
}

read_gse293559_expression <- function(file) {
  message("Reading GSE293559 processed expression matrix: ", file)

  dt <- data.table::fread(file, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  if (!"Library name" %in% colnames(dt)) {
    stop("Expected first/sample column named 'Library name' in GSE293559 processed data.")
  }

  sample_names <- as.character(dt[["Library name"]])

  expr_df <- dt[, setdiff(colnames(dt), "Library name"), drop = FALSE]

  mat <- as.matrix(expr_df)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  rownames(mat) <- sample_names

  # Current orientation: samples x transcript/features.
  # Convert to features x samples.
  mat <- t(mat)

  feature_id <- rownames(mat)
  ensembl_gene <- extract_ensembl_gene_id(feature_id)

  mapping <- data.frame(
    feature_id = feature_id,
    ensembl_gene = ensembl_gene,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  valid <- !is.na(mapping$ensembl_gene)

  gene_symbols <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(mapping$ensembl_gene[valid]),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  mapping$gene_symbol <- NA_character_
  mapping$gene_symbol[valid] <- as.character(gene_symbols[mapping$ensembl_gene[valid]])

  keep <- !is.na(mapping$gene_symbol) & mapping$gene_symbol != ""

  mat2 <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat2) <- mapping$gene_symbol[keep]

  # Multiple transcripts/features per gene symbol: average them.
  mat2 <- collapse_duplicate_rows(mat2, method = "mean")

  list(
    expr = mat2,
    mapping = mapping
  )
}


############################
# 3. Archived candidate pools; pre-data specification not established
############################
# These are broad biologically interpretable candidate pools.
# The final signature is selected only from GSE151371 stability analysis.
# GSE293559 is never used for feature selection.

innate_candidate_pool <- unique(c(
  "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12",
  "ANXA3", "CLEC4D", "FCGR1A", "FCGR1B", "FCGR2A", "FCGR3A",
  "BST1", "IRAK3", "TLR2", "TLR4", "TLR5", "TLR8",
  "NLRC4", "BCL2A1", "MIR223", "QPCT", "SLC37A3", "SLC22A4",
  "PLIN3", "CD14", "IL1B", "IL1R1", "IL1RN", "NLRP3",
  "LYZ", "FCN1", "LST1", "CTSS", "CTSD", "LGALS3",
  "LILRB1", "LILRB2", "MS4A7", "MNDA", "CEACAM8",
  "MPO", "ELANE", "OLR1", "ARG1", "RETN", "HP",
  "CXCL1", "CXCL2", "CXCL8", "CXCR1", "CXCR2",
  "C5AR1", "FPR1", "FPR2", "ITGAM", "ITGAX",
  "TYROBP", "AIF1", "S100P", "VCAN", "NAMPT"
))

adaptive_candidate_pool <- unique(c(
  "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G",
  "TRAC", "TRBC1", "TRBC2",
  "IL7R", "CCR7", "TCF7", "LEF1",
  "ZAP70", "LCK", "LAT", "CD247",
  "CD27", "CD28", "CD2", "LTB",
  "FOXP3", "RUNX3", "GATA3", "CXCR3",
  "IL2RB", "IL2RG", "CD40LG",
  "KLRD1", "NKG7", "GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMB", "GZMA",
  "GZMK", "KLRB1", "KLRF1", "KLRK1",
  "MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B",
  "HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1",
  "CD74", "ICOS", "ITK", "BCL11B", "SELL"
))


############################
# 4. GSE151371 discovery analysis
############################

message("\n==============================")
message("Step 1: GSE151371 discovery")
message("==============================")

counts151 <- read_count_matrix(gse151371_count_file)
meta151 <- read_metadata_or_infer(colnames(counts151), gse151371_meta_file)

# Reorder columns and metadata.
meta151 <- meta151[match(colnames(counts151), meta151$sample), , drop = FALSE]

message("GSE151371 group counts:")
print(table(meta151$group))

if (!all(c("HC", "TC", "SCI") %in% meta151$group)) {
  stop("GSE151371 must contain HC, TC, and SCI groups.")
}

fit151 <- run_voom_limma(counts151, meta151)

de_sci_tc <- top_table_all(fit151$fit, "SCI_vs_TC")
de_sci_hc <- top_table_all(fit151$fit, "SCI_vs_HC")
de_tc_hc  <- top_table_all(fit151$fit, "TC_vs_HC")

data.table::fwrite(de_sci_tc, file.path(outdir_discovery, "GSE151371_DE_SCI_vs_TC_primary.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(de_sci_hc, file.path(outdir_discovery, "GSE151371_DE_SCI_vs_HC_supporting.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(de_tc_hc,  file.path(outdir_discovery, "GSE151371_DE_TC_vs_HC_audit.csv"))

report_deg_counts <- function(tt, contrast) {
  data.frame(
    contrast = contrast,
    up = sum(tt$adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff_report & tt$logFC > logfc_cutoff_report, na.rm = TRUE),
    down = sum(tt$adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff_report & tt$logFC < -logfc_cutoff_report, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

deg_summary <- rbind(
  report_deg_counts(de_sci_tc, "SCI_vs_TC"),
  report_deg_counts(de_sci_hc, "SCI_vs_HC"),
  report_deg_counts(de_tc_hc, "TC_vs_HC")
)

data.table::fwrite(deg_summary, file.path(outdir_discovery, "GSE151371_DEG_count_summary.csv"))


############################
# 5. Stability selection in GSE151371
############################

message("\n==============================")
message("Step 2: Stability selection")
message("==============================")

expr_genes <- rownames(fit151$v$E)

innate_pool_present <- intersect(innate_candidate_pool, expr_genes)
adaptive_pool_present <- intersect(adaptive_candidate_pool, expr_genes)

message("Innate candidate genes present in GSE151371: ", length(innate_pool_present))
message("Adaptive candidate genes present in GSE151371: ", length(adaptive_pool_present))

if (length(innate_pool_present) < min_genes_per_module) {
  stop("Too few innate candidate genes present in GSE151371.")
}
if (length(adaptive_pool_present) < min_genes_per_module) {
  stop("Too few adaptive candidate genes present in GSE151371.")
}

stability_record <- data.frame(
  gene = c(innate_pool_present, adaptive_pool_present),
  module = c(rep("innate", length(innate_pool_present)), rep("adaptive", length(adaptive_pool_present))),
  selected_n = 0,
  tested_n = 0,
  direction_correct_n = 0,
  mean_logFC_SCI_vs_TC = 0,
  mean_logFC_SCI_vs_HC = 0,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (b in seq_len(B)) {
  if (b %% 25 == 0) {
    message("Stability iteration: ", b, " / ", B)
  }

  sampled_samples <- unlist(lapply(levels(meta151$group), function(g) {
    ss <- meta151$sample[meta151$group == g]
    n_take <- max(2, floor(length(ss) * subsample_fraction))
    sample(ss, n_take, replace = FALSE)
  }))

  counts_b <- counts151[, sampled_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_b <- meta151[match(sampled_samples, meta151$sample), , drop = FALSE]

  fit_b <- tryCatch(
    run_voom_limma(counts_b, meta_b),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_b)) {
    next
  }

  tt_primary <- top_table_all(fit_b$fit, "SCI_vs_TC")
  tt_support <- top_table_all(fit_b$fit, "SCI_vs_HC")

  rownames(tt_primary) <- tt_primary$gene
  rownames(tt_support) <- tt_support$gene

  # Innate: higher in SCI than TC and directionally higher than HC.
  innate_present_b <- intersect(innate_pool_present, rownames(tt_primary))
  innate_df <- data.frame(
    gene = innate_present_b,
    logFC_primary = tt_primary[innate_present_b, "logFC"],
    p_primary = tt_primary[innate_present_b, "P.Value"],
    logFC_support = tt_support[innate_present_b, "logFC"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  innate_df$direction_ok <- innate_df$logFC_primary > 0 & innate_df$logFC_support > 0
  innate_df <- innate_df[order(innate_df$p_primary), , drop = FALSE]
  selected_innate <- head(innate_df$gene[innate_df$direction_ok], top_n_per_module_per_iteration)

  # Adaptive: lower in SCI than TC and directionally lower than HC.
  adaptive_present_b <- intersect(adaptive_pool_present, rownames(tt_primary))
  adaptive_df <- data.frame(
    gene = adaptive_present_b,
    logFC_primary = tt_primary[adaptive_present_b, "logFC"],
    p_primary = tt_primary[adaptive_present_b, "P.Value"],
    logFC_support = tt_support[adaptive_present_b, "logFC"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  adaptive_df$direction_ok <- adaptive_df$logFC_primary < 0 & adaptive_df$logFC_support < 0
  adaptive_df <- adaptive_df[order(adaptive_df$p_primary), , drop = FALSE]
  selected_adaptive <- head(adaptive_df$gene[adaptive_df$direction_ok], top_n_per_module_per_iteration)

  # Update records.
  update_one_module <- function(module_name, df_module, selected_genes) {
    idx <- match(df_module$gene, stability_record$gene)
    idx <- idx[!is.na(idx) & stability_record$module[idx] == module_name]

    stability_record$tested_n[idx] <<- stability_record$tested_n[idx] + 1

    direction_correct <- df_module$direction_ok[match(stability_record$gene[idx], df_module$gene)]
    direction_correct[is.na(direction_correct)] <- FALSE

    stability_record$direction_correct_n[idx] <<-
      stability_record$direction_correct_n[idx] + as.integer(direction_correct)

    lf1 <- df_module$logFC_primary[match(stability_record$gene[idx], df_module$gene)]
    lf2 <- df_module$logFC_support[match(stability_record$gene[idx], df_module$gene)]

    lf1[is.na(lf1)] <- 0
    lf2[is.na(lf2)] <- 0

    stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_TC[idx] <<-
      stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_TC[idx] + lf1

    stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_HC[idx] <<-
      stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_HC[idx] + lf2

    sel_idx <- match(selected_genes, stability_record$gene)
    sel_idx <- sel_idx[!is.na(sel_idx) & stability_record$module[sel_idx] == module_name]

    stability_record$selected_n[sel_idx] <<-
      stability_record$selected_n[sel_idx] + 1
  }

  update_one_module("innate", innate_df, selected_innate)
  update_one_module("adaptive", adaptive_df, selected_adaptive)
}

stability_record$selection_frequency <- stability_record$selected_n / B
stability_record$direction_consistency <- stability_record$direction_correct_n / pmax(stability_record$tested_n, 1)
stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_TC <- stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_TC / pmax(stability_record$tested_n, 1)
stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_HC <- stability_record$mean_logFC_SCI_vs_HC / pmax(stability_record$tested_n, 1)

# Add full-data DE statistics.
rownames(de_sci_tc) <- de_sci_tc$gene
rownames(de_sci_hc) <- de_sci_hc$gene

stability_record$full_logFC_SCI_vs_TC <- de_sci_tc[stability_record$gene, "logFC"]
stability_record$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC <- de_sci_tc[stability_record$gene, "adj.P.Val"]
stability_record$full_logFC_SCI_vs_HC <- de_sci_hc[stability_record$gene, "logFC"]
stability_record$full_FDR_SCI_vs_HC <- de_sci_hc[stability_record$gene, "adj.P.Val"]

stability_record <- stability_record[order(
  stability_record$module,
  -stability_record$selection_frequency,
  -stability_record$direction_consistency,
  stability_record$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC
), ]

data.table::fwrite(
  stability_record,
  file.path(outdir_discovery, "GSE151371_stability_selection_all_candidates.csv")
)

lock_module <- function(stab, module_name) {
  d <- stab[stab$module == module_name, , drop = FALSE]

  if (module_name == "innate") {
    direction_full_ok <- d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_TC > 0 & d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_HC > 0
  } else {
    direction_full_ok <- d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_TC < 0 & d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_HC < 0
  }

  locked <- d[
    d$selection_frequency >= min_selection_frequency &
      d$direction_consistency >= min_direction_consistency &
      direction_full_ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  locked <- locked[order(
    -locked$selection_frequency,
    -locked$direction_consistency,
    locked$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC
  ), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(locked) < min_genes_per_module) {
    warning(
      "Fewer than ", min_genes_per_module,
      " genes passed strict threshold for ", module_name,
      ". Falling back to top-ranked stable direction-consistent genes."
    )

    fallback <- d[direction_full_ok, , drop = FALSE]
    fallback <- fallback[order(
      -fallback$selection_frequency,
      -fallback$direction_consistency,
      fallback$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC
    ), , drop = FALSE]

    locked <- head(fallback, min_genes_per_module)
  }

  head(locked, max_genes_per_module)
}

locked_innate <- lock_module(stability_record, "innate")
locked_adaptive <- lock_module(stability_record, "adaptive")

data.table::fwrite(

  file.path(outdir_discovery, "locked_innate_gene_set_v1.csv")
)

data.table::fwrite(

locked_signature <- list(

  validation_dataset = "GSE293559",
  primary_contrast = "SCI_vs_TC",
  supporting_contrast = "SCI_vs_HC",
  stability_selection = list(
    B = B,
    subsample_fraction = subsample_fraction,
    top_n_per_module_per_iteration = top_n_per_module_per_iteration,
    min_selection_frequency = min_selection_frequency,
    min_direction_consistency = min_direction_consistency,
    min_genes_per_module = min_genes_per_module,
    max_genes_per_module = max_genes_per_module
  ),
  innate_genes = locked_innate$gene,
  adaptive_genes = locked_adaptive$gene,
  score_formula = list(
    innate_score = "mean control-referenced z-score of locked innate genes",
    adaptive_score = "mean control-referenced z-score of locked adaptive genes",
    balance_score = "innate_score - adaptive_score"
  )
)

jsonlite::write_json(
  locked_signature,
  path = file.path(outdir_discovery, "locked_signature_v1.json"),
  pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

message("\nLocked innate genes:")
print(locked_innate$gene)

message("\nLocked adaptive genes:")
print(locked_adaptive$gene)


############################

lm_results <- list()

run_lm_if_possible <- function(df, score_col) {
  d <- df[is.finite(df[[score_col]]) & df$group %in% c("CTL", "SCI"), , drop = FALSE]
  d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

  rhs <- "group"

  if ("platform" %in% colnames(d) && length(unique(na.omit(d$platform))) > 1) {
    tab <- table(d$group, d$platform)
    if (all(rowSums(tab > 0) >= 1) && all(colSums(tab > 0) >= 1)) {
      rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ platform")
    }
  }

  if ("age" %in% colnames(d)) {
    suppressWarnings(d$age_numeric <- as.numeric(d$age))
    if (sum(is.finite(d$age_numeric)) >= 10) {
      rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ age_numeric")
    }
  }

  if ("sex" %in% colnames(d)) {
    if (length(unique(na.omit(d$sex))) > 1) {
      rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ sex")
    }
  } else if ("Sex" %in% colnames(d)) {
    d$sex <- d$Sex
    if (length(unique(na.omit(d$sex))) > 1) {
      rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ sex")
    }
  }

  form <- as.formula(paste(score_col, "~", rhs))

  fit <- tryCatch(lm(form, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  co <- as.data.frame(co)
  co$term <- rownames(co)
  rownames(co) <- NULL
  co$score <- score_col
  co$formula <- paste(deparse(form), collapse = "")

  co
}

for (sc in score_cols) {
  lm_results[[sc]] <- run_lm_if_possible(scores293, sc)
}

lm_results <- do.call(rbind, lm_results)

if (!is.null(lm_results) && nrow(lm_results) > 0) {
  data.table::fwrite(
    lm_results,
    file.path(outdir_validation, "GSE293559_validation_lm_sensitivity.csv")
  )
```

```{r}
############################################################
# GSE293559 external validation plotting
# Main figure + sensitivity figure
#
# Input:
#   GSE293559_locked_signature_scores.csv
#   GSE293559_locked_signature_gene_coverage.csv
#
# Output:
#   03_GSE293559_validation_figures/
#     Fig_GSE293559_external_validation_main.pdf
#     SuppFig_GSE293559_sensitivity_exclude_reused_SCI.pdf
#     GSE293559_plot_statistics.csv
############################################################


############################
# 0. Settings
############################

set.seed(20260714)

score_file <- "GSE293559_locked_signature_scores.csv"
coverage_file <- "GSE293559_locked_signature_gene_coverage.csv"

outdir <- "03_GSE293559_validation_figures"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Colors can be adjusted later if needed.
group_colors <- c(
  "CTL" = "#6E6E6E",
  "SCI" = "#D73027"
)

# Figure size
single_panel_width <- 4.2
single_panel_height <- 4.2

combined_width <- 12.0
combined_height <- 4.2


############################
# 1. Load packages
############################

cran_pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "readr", "patchwork")

for (pkg in cran_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)


############################
# 2. Helper functions
############################

to_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x %in% c("true", "t", "yes", "y", "1")
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("P = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(paste0("P = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)))
  } else {
    return(paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
  }
}

format_g <- function(g) {
  if (is.na(g)) return("g = NA")
  paste0("g = ", sprintf("%.2f", g))
}

hedges_g <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]

  nx <- length(x)
  ny <- length(y)

  if (nx < 2 || ny < 2) return(NA_real_)

  sx <- stats::var(x)
  sy <- stats::var(y)

  sp <- sqrt(((nx - 1) * sx + (ny - 1) * sy) / (nx + ny - 2))

  if (!is.finite(sp) || sp == 0) return(NA_real_)

  d <- (mean(x) - mean(y)) / sp

  # Small-sample correction
  J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (nx + ny) - 9)

  d * J
}

compare_sci_vs_ctl <- function(df, score_col, analysis_name) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(group %in% c("CTL", "SCI")) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[score_col]]))

  x <- d %>% filter(group == "SCI") %>% pull(.data[[score_col]])
  y <- d %>% filter(group == "CTL") %>% pull(.data[[score_col]])

  p <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  g <- hedges_g(x, y)

  tibble(
    analysis = analysis_name,
    score = score_col,
    n_CTL = length(y),
    n_SCI = length(x),
    mean_CTL = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SCI = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_CTL = median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_SCI = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference_SCI_minus_CTL = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    hedges_g_SCI_vs_CTL = g,
    wilcox_p = p
  )
}

make_score_plot <- function(df, score_col, panel_title, y_lab, analysis_name) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(group %in% c("CTL", "SCI")) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[score_col]]))

  d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

  stat <- compare_sci_vs_ctl(d, score_col, analysis_name)

  n_ctl <- stat$n_CTL
  n_sci <- stat$n_SCI

  x_labels <- c(
    "CTL" = paste0("CTL\nn=", n_ctl),
    "SCI" = paste0("SCI\nn=", n_sci)
  )

  y_max <- max(d[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_range <- 1
  }

  y_annot <- y_max + 0.12 * y_range

  annot_text <- paste0(
    format_p(stat$wilcox_p),
    "\n",
    format_g(stat$hedges_g_SCI_vs_CTL)
  )

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = .data[[score_col]], fill = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.55,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = group),
      width = 0.11,
      height = 0,
      size = 2.4,
      alpha = 0.88
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_annot,
      label = annot_text,
      size = 3.4
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_min - 0.08 * y_range, y_max + 0.28 * y_range),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.45),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )

  list(plot = p, stats = stat)
}

scores <- read_csv(score_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
coverage <- read_csv(coverage_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Harmonize sample column

scores$group <- factor(scores$group, levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

  scores$reused_from_gse226238 <- to_logical_safe(scores$reused_from_gse226238)

  # Reused SCI: ID1v0-ID10v0

  subject_id <- sub("v0$", "", scores$sample, ignore.case = TRUE)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Publication-style GSE293559 validation figure
# Main figure + sensitivity figure
#
# Input files:
#   GSE293559_locked_signature_scores.csv
#   GSE293559_locked_signature_gene_coverage.csv
#
# Output:
#   03_GSE293559_validation_figures_pub/
#     Fig_GSE293559_external_validation_main_pub.pdf
#     SuppFig_GSE293559_sensitivity_exclude_reused_SCI_pub.pdf
############################################################


############################
# 0. Settings
############################

set.seed(20260714)

score_file <- "GSE293559_locked_signature_scores.csv"
coverage_file <- "GSE293559_locked_signature_gene_coverage.csv"

outdir <- "03_GSE293559_validation_figures_pub"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Figure size required by previous manuscript style
fig_width_mm <- 180
fig_height_mm <- 65

single_panel_width_mm <- 60
single_panel_height_mm <- 65

# Colors
group_colors <- c(
  "CTL" = "#7A7A7A",
  "SCI" = "#D73027"
)

# Font family
# Use "sans" for cross-platform compatibility.
# If Arial is available on your system, you can change this to "Arial".
base_family <- "sans"


############################
# 1. Packages
############################

pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "readr", "patchwork")

for (pkg in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)


############################
# 2. Helper functions
############################

to_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x %in% c("true", "t", "yes", "y", "1")
}

hedges_g <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  y <- y[is.finite(y)]

  nx <- length(x)
  ny <- length(y)

  if (nx < 2 || ny < 2) return(NA_real_)

  sx <- var(x)
  sy <- var(y)

  sp <- sqrt(((nx - 1) * sx + (ny - 1) * sy) / (nx + ny - 2))

  if (!is.finite(sp) || sp == 0) return(NA_real_)

  d <- (mean(x) - mean(y)) / sp
  J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (nx + ny) - 9)

  d * J
}

format_p_pub <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("P = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) return("P < 0.001")
  paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

format_g_pub <- function(g) {
  if (is.na(g)) return("Hedges' g = NA")
  paste0("Hedges' g = ", sprintf("%.2f", g))
}

compare_sci_vs_ctl <- function(df, score_col, analysis_name) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(group %in% c("CTL", "SCI")) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[score_col]]))

  x <- d %>% filter(group == "SCI") %>% pull(.data[[score_col]])
  y <- d %>% filter(group == "CTL") %>% pull(.data[[score_col]])

  p <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  g <- hedges_g(x, y)

  data.frame(
    analysis = analysis_name,
    score = score_col,
    n_CTL = length(y),
    n_SCI = length(x),
    mean_CTL = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SCI = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_CTL = median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_SCI = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference_SCI_minus_CTL = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    hedges_g_SCI_vs_CTL = g,
    wilcox_p = p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

make_pub_score_plot <- function(
    df,
    score_col,
    panel_label,
    panel_title,
    y_lab,
    analysis_name
) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(group %in% c("CTL", "SCI")) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[score_col]]))

  d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

  stat <- compare_sci_vs_ctl(d, score_col, analysis_name)

  x_labels <- c(
    "CTL" = paste0("CTL\nn=", stat$n_CTL),
    "SCI" = paste0("SCI\nn=", stat$n_SCI)
  )

  y_min <- min(d[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(d[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_range <- 1
  }

  y_lower <- y_min - 0.10 * y_range
  y_upper <- y_max + 0.30 * y_range
  y_annot <- y_max + 0.13 * y_range

  annot_text <- paste0(
    format_p_pub(stat$wilcox_p),
    "\n",
    format_g_pub(stat$hedges_g_SCI_vs_CTL)
  )

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = .data[[score_col]], fill = group)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.52,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.78,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = group),
      width = 0.105,
      height = 0,
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.88
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_annot,
      label = annot_text,
      size = 2.8,
      family = base_family,
      lineheight = 0.92
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(panel_label, "  ", panel_title),
      x = NULL,
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(b = 5)
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 9.5,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 8.5,
        color = "black",
        lineheight = 0.9
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 8.5,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.45,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.4,
        color = "black"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(1.5, "mm"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 4,
        r = 7,
        b = 4,
        l = 7
      )
    )

  list(plot = p, stats = stat)
}


############################
# 3. Read data
############################

scores <- read_csv(score_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
coverage <- read_csv(coverage_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Harmonize sample column
if (!"sample" %in% colnames(scores)) {
  if ("library_name" %in% colnames(scores)) {
    scores$sample <- scores$library_name
  } else if ("Library name" %in% colnames(scores)) {
    scores$sample <- scores$`Library name`
  } else {
    stop("Cannot find sample/library_name column.")
  }
}

# Harmonize group
scores$group <- toupper(as.character(scores$group))
scores$group[scores$group %in% c("CONTROL", "CTRL", "UNINJURED")] <- "CTL"
scores$group <- factor(scores$group, levels = c("CTL", "SCI"))

# Harmonize reused flag
if ("reused_from_gse226238" %in% colnames(scores)) {
  scores$reused_from_gse226238 <- to_logical_safe(scores$reused_from_gse226238)
} else {
  subject_id <- sub("v0$", "", scores$sample, ignore.case = TRUE)

    paste0("ID", 1:10),

if (length(missing_score_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing score columns: ", paste(missing_score_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("\nGroup counts:\n")
print(table(scores$group, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nReused-from-GSE226238 counts:\n")

cat("\nGene coverage:\n")
print(coverage)


############################

############################

main_df <- scores %>%

fig_main <- pA$plot + pB$plot + pC$plot +

ggsave(

#    CTL samples are retained because no non-reused CTL exists.
############################

sensitivity_df <- scores %>%

sA <- make_pub_score_plot(

fig_sensitivity <- sA$plot + sB$plot + sC$plot +

  useDingbats = FALSE
)


############################
# 7. Save statistics table
############################

plot_stats <- bind_rows(
  pA$stats,
  pB$stats,
  pC$stats,
  sA$stats,
  sB$stats,
  sC$stats
)

write_csv(
  plot_stats,
  file.path(outdir, "GSE293559_plot_statistics_pub.csv")
)

cat("\nPlot statistics:\n")
print(plot_stats)

cat("\nFinished.\n")
cat("Main figure:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "Fig_GSE293559_external_validation_main_pub.pdf"), "\n")
cat("Sensitivity figure:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "SuppFig_GSE293559_sensitivity_exclude_reused_SCI_pub.pdf"), "\n")
```
